pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions (anti-martingale/no falling knife averaging) until the primary order has achieved at least +$15.00 floating profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entry authorized during periods where ATR(14) expands greater than 2.5x the 50-period moving average of volatility, and requires an explicit order-flow imbalance ratio > 1.8.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing or partial profit-taking once open trade returns cross +$15.00 to guarantee asymmetric $15-$30+ wins.
